name: take1
description: The smart contract project is pushed to GitHub on branch smartcontract Clone the repo: git clone <repo-url> and checkout the branch: git checkout smartcontract To set up locally: npm install Run local Hardhat node in one terminal: npx hardhat node Deploy contracts in another terminal: npx hardhat run scripts/deploy.js This deploys the FarmerEscrowFactory — note down the factory address from the console output
